about: Sample I can statements. Replace the text with the school's own; keep each id stable once students link to it. competencies lists the competency ids whose evidence can back a statement: critical, adaptive, inventive, communication, collaboration, information, civic, global, crosscultural, selfaware, selfmanage, socialaware, relationship, decisions. For statements by level, see example-banded.json.
title: Sample statements

statements.text: I can weigh evidence before I decide, and say why I chose.
I can use what I know in a new situation, and change my approach when it is not working.
I can ask my own questions and test ideas that are not in the notes.
I can explain an idea clearly for my listener, and check that they followed.
I can share the work and the decisions in a group, and make room for others.
I can find, check and combine information, and say where it came from.
I can connect what I learn to life in Singapore, and play my part in my community.
I can link what I learn to issues in the wider world.
I can notice how people from other backgrounds might see things, and respond with respect.
I can name what I feel, and what I am good and not yet good at.
I can manage my time, effort and feelings to reach a goal.
I can notice how others feel and see things.
I can build and repair relationships, and ask for help.
I can make choices that are good for me and fair to others.
